shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
lore-query-trace --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,160p'
git status --short --branch
git log -4 --oneline
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '65,115p'
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix validator cache test lint" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
